note: Curated HISTORICAL DAMAGE record for the dashboard's Past-events view — SEPARATE from ramban_documented_landslides.geojson (the validated back-test inventory), which is deliberately untouched. Verification rule (CLAUDE.md / ledger §12g, §36-§38): every event is checked against a primary source (peer-reviewed paper or GSI) or 2+ independent press outlets; publication date != event date; LOW-confidence rows are flagged review_needed for the user and rendered as pending review, never as settled fact. Ranking = deaths desc, then injured, then damage_score (0-10 editorial judgment of infrastructure/livelihood damage, used only to break ties among non-fatal events). Coordinates are approximate place centroids (same convention as the back-test inventory), NOT field-mapped scarps.

events.name: Khooni Nallah T3 tunnel-portal collapse (Digdol–Panthyal four-laning)
events.damage: Landslide + shooting stones during portal-support work collapsed the false steel portal onto the under-construction tunnel; 10 workers killed; contractor fined Rs 8.46 crore and barred from central projects for 6 months
events.trigger: Slope failure / rock-mass fall during construction (night ~22:30 IST; not reported as rainfall-triggered)
events.confidence_reason: Multiple independent national outlets consistent on date, location and toll; central-government probe and contractor fine on public record

sources.label: Business Standard, 12 Oct 2022 (Rs 8.5 cr fine for collapse that killed 10)

events.name: Gangroo–Ramsu boulder strike (NH-44, Ramban)
events.coord_confidence: approximate_place_centroid (Gangroo, near Ramsu/Ramsoo; LOW spatial precision — exact km-marker not published)
events.damage: Boulders/shooting stones struck a Tempo Traveller (Banihal->Doda) at Gangroo near Ramsu at ~13:20 IST, killing a couple from Doda (Nazir Ahmed, Shakeela Begum); 4 passengers and a traffic sub-inspector (SI Mohd Ashraf) injured. NH-44 suspended from ~09:30 the same day; part of a multi-day monsoon disaster (~23-25 rain-related deaths across Jammu province since 19 Jul, 7 missing; in Ramban ~8 houses damaged + ~22 link roads blocked over 3 days)
events.trigger: Rainfall-triggered rockfall during the 19-22 Jul 2026 monsoon spell (24 h to 22 Jul: Udhampur 112.6 mm, Katra 58.5 mm; Kathua 153, Samba 133 regionally). Gate cross-check: the experimental IMERG sub-daily gate ran WATCH/ALERT continuously 17-23 Jul (ALERT 18 Jul E=3.05, four days before; WATCH on the event day 22 Jul E=2.44 — 20.8 mm/6 h AOI-mean). The validated daily ERA5-Land gate was WATCH 14-16 Jul (E~1.0-1.15) then latency-blind to 19-22 Jul (its data ends 18 Jul as of the 24 Jul fetch); daily-arm confirmation pending ERA5-Land publication (~27 Jul). Ledger §62
events.confidence_reason: Event date/time unambiguous (22 Jul 2026 ~1:20 pm) across 3 independent outlets; publication 22-23 Jul. Injured count varies by outlet (a wire says 3, headlines say 4; the most detailed account — Daily Excelsior — gives 4 passengers + traffic SI = 5, adopted here). Coordinates are the Gangroo/Ramsu place centroid, not a field-mapped scarp
